title: Drumm puts his head in the magnetic hole at Oami Gaishi stone circle

tellings.quote: like sticking my head in this. It's exactly a head-shaped hole in this huge anesite stone that has this profound magnetic field

plain: At the Oami Gaishi stone circle in Japan, there is a huge andesite stone with a hole exactly the shape of a head and a strong magnetic field, and he put his head inside it, says Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who says an alien showed him the true purpose of the pyramids. Drumm tells it as something he did himself in the 2020s, a hint to him that ancient stones were built for a purpose involving magnetism.
